T0568.title: Vector Database
T0568.definition: A database optimized for storing embeddings and performing similarity search over unstructured content.
T0568.description: Vector databases store embeddings for text, images, or behavior data to support similarity search and RAG. Risks include cross-tenant retrieval, sensitive-fragment recall, index poisoning, and incomplete deletion. Controls focus on namespace isolation, metadata permissions, retrieval logs, data masking, and index lifecycle management.
T0568.usageExample: Assess Vector Database related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
